exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.reason_uk: Назва Bicycle Crunch, але англійський текст описує звичайний crunch із стопами на опорі без велосипедного руху або обертання.
exercises.question_uk: Потрібен велосипедний рух із протилежним ліктем/коліном чи звичайний crunch за текстом?

source_english.description: Bicycle Crunch curls the ribs toward the pelvis from a supine bent-knee position.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Brace and curl the ribs toward the pelvis.
Pause without pulling the neck.
Lower the torso slowly to the support.
source_english.safety_note: Use a comfortable curl range and reduce the decline or load before the neck or back loses control.

exercises.name: Diamond Push Up
exercises.reason_uk: Текст не визначає ромб із великих/вказівних пальців і містить умовну згадку clap; хват істотно впливає на позу.
exercises.question_uk: Для цього ID потрібні долоні ромбом без clap чи інший вузький хват?

source_english.description: Diamond Push Up lowers the chest from a braced plank and presses back up with the hands close beneath the chest.
instructions: Set a straight plank with hands under or just inside the shoulders.
Lower the chest toward the floor while keeping the trunk rigid.
Press through the palms; for clap push-ups, leave the floor briefly and land softly.
Reset the plank with elbows straight before the next repetition.
form_cues: Keep the body in one line.
source_english.safety_note: Use knees or an elevated surface until the plank and landing stay controlled.

exercises.name: Floor Triceps Dip
exercises.reason_uk: Description згадує паралельні опори, instructions — сидячи на підлозі з долонями позаду стегон.
exercises.question_uk: Виконувати floor dip із долонями на підлозі чи dip на паралельних опорах?

source_english.description: The Floor Triceps Dip lowers the body by bending the elbows between parallel supports, then presses back up while the shoulders remain controlled.
instructions: Sit with knees bent and hands behind the hips, fingers forward.
Press through the hands to lift the hips slightly.
Bend the elbows to lower the hips a short distance.
Straighten the elbows to return without shrugging.
common_mistakes: Moving the hips instead of the elbows.
source_english.safety_note: Limit depth or use assistance if the front of the shoulder loses control.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
exercises.reason_uk: primary_muscle=full_body: немає конкретних груп для локальної підсвітки v1 без суцільного помаранчевого тіла.
exercises.question_uk: Які конкретні основні й допоміжні м’язи підсвітити?

source_english.description: Downward Dog lifts the hips up and back from the hands, lengthening the spine while the knees may stay softly bent.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under the shoulders.
Press the floor away and lift the hips up and back.
Keep the spine long and bend the knees as needed.
Hold steady breaths, then return to the hands-and-knees position.
source_english.safety_note: Keep the wrist load within a comfortable range and do not force the heels down.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.reason_uk: primary_muscle=full_body: немає конкретних груп для локальної підсвітки v1.
exercises.question_uk: Які конкретні основні й допоміжні м’язи підсвітити?

source_english.description: Bear Crawl keeps the knees hovering while opposite hands and feet advance in short, controlled steps.
instructions: Start on hands and feet with knees hovering just above the floor.
Move the opposite hand and foot forward together.
Keep the hips low and continue alternating without rotating the trunk.
Reverse or continue for the planned distance or time.
source_english.safety_note: Clear the floor and stop before wrist or shoulder support breaks down.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
exercises.reason_uk: primary_muscle=full_body: немає конкретних груп для локальної підсвітки v1.
exercises.question_uk: Які конкретні основні й допоміжні м’язи підсвітити?

source_english.description: Jump the feet apart as the arms rise overhead, then return both to the starting position.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump up, spreading your feet apart and raising your arms above your head.
As you land, quickly jump back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
source_english.safety_note: Choose a pace and surface that allow controlled breathing and stable landings.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.reason_uk: primary_muscle=full_body: немає конкретних груп для локальної підсвітки v1.
exercises.question_uk: Які конкретні основні й допоміжні м’язи підсвітити?

source_english.description: High Knees alternates knee drives toward hip height with the torso upright and each foot landing softly.
instructions: Stand tall with arms relaxed and brace the abdomen.
Drive the right knee toward hip height while the left foot supports the body.
Switch legs with a small hop for skips or a quick step for high knees.
Continue alternating for the programmed repetitions.
source_english.safety_note: Use a clear, non-slip surface and lower the cadence before knee or ankle control fades.

exercises.name: Lying Neck Extension
exercises.reason_uk: Вказано prescribed supported position та вільну голову, але не орієнтацію тулуба/опору.
exercises.question_uk: Лежачи на животі чи на спині; яка опора під тулубом і де розташована голова?

source_english.description: Lying neck extension gently moves the head backward from a supported neutral position while the torso stays still.
instructions: Lie in the prescribed supported position with the head free and shoulders relaxed.
Start with the neck in a neutral line and brace lightly.
Extend the head a small distance while keeping the torso still.
Return slowly to neutral without dropping the head.
source_english.safety_note: Perform only a gentle unloaded range and stop for any neck pain, headache, or dizziness.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.reason_uk: Текст не визначає чітко положення лежачи/кут лави й говорить про chest support as required.
exercises.question_uk: Потрібен fly лежачи спиною на горизонтальній лаві чи інше положення/кут?

source_english.description: The Chest Fly (Dumbbell) opens and closes the arms around the chest with a soft elbow bend rather than turning the motion into a press.
instructions: Set up on the dumbbells with a soft bend in the elbows and the chest supported as required.
Open the arms only as far as the shoulders remain comfortable.
Bring the hands together by squeezing the chest without changing the elbow angle.
Return slowly to the starting position.
form_cues: Move through the chest, not the wrists.
common_mistakes: Turning the movement into a press.
source_english.safety_note: Use a light load and stop before the shoulder reaches an uncomfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Incline Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.reason_uk: Description: 45-degree bench і руки позаду тулуба; instructions: upper arms resting on incline bench.
exercises.question_uk: Плечі вільно звисають біля тулуба чи спираються на похилу поверхню?

source_english.description: Sit on a 45-degree incline with arms hanging behind the torso, curl both dumbbells toward the shoulders, then lower them.
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Rest your upper arms on the incline bench and let your elbows hang down, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
form_cues: Keep the upper arms or thighs still.
source_english.safety_note: Choose resistance that keeps the elbow and wrist path controlled.

exercises.name: Cross Body Hammer Curl
exercises.reason_uk: equipment=dumbbell, але текст згадує barbell із neutral grip та не визначає cross-body траєкторію.
exercises.question_uk: Підтвердьте гантель, нейтральний хват і рух до протилежного плеча, або уточніть задуманий варіант.

source_english.description: Cross Body Hammer Curl curls the barbell toward the shoulders with the neutral grip, keeping the upper arms controlled.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with the barbell and use a neutral grip.
Keep the upper arms still and curl the resistance toward the shoulders.
Pause at the top without lifting the elbows.
Lower slowly until the elbows are nearly straight.
source_english.safety_note: Use a load or band tension that allows a controlled elbow path and return.

exercises.name: Waiter Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.reason_uk: Текст описує звичайний curl з двома гантелями долонями вперед, не визначає характерний waiter хват.
exercises.question_uk: Яка кількість гантелей, хват і положення рук для Waiter Curl?

source_english.description: Waiter Curl (Dumbbell) curls both dumbbells from a palms-forward standing position while the elbows stay close to the body.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold one dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward.
Keep the upper arms beside the ribs and curl both dumbbells toward the shoulders.
Pause at the top without lifting the elbows.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until the elbows are nearly straight.
source_english.safety_note: Use dumbbells you can lower without leaning or swinging.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.reason_uk: equipment=dumbbell, але текст описує barbell curl і не визначає опору ліктя/плеча.
exercises.question_uk: Підтвердьте одну гантель, сидяче положення й точну опору ліктя або задайте інший варіант.

source_english.description: Concentration Curl curls the barbell toward the shoulders with the underhand grip, keeping the upper arms controlled.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with the barbell and use a underhand grip.
Keep the upper arms still and curl the resistance toward the shoulders.
Pause at the top without lifting the elbows.
Lower slowly until the elbows are nearly straight.
source_english.safety_note: Use a load or band tension that allows a controlled elbow path and return.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch Raised Legs

exercises.question_uk: Потрібен велосипедний рух з піднятими ногами чи звичайний crunch зі стопами на опорі?

source_english.description: Bicycle Crunch Raised Legs curls the ribs toward the pelvis from a supine bent-knee position.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Brace and curl the ribs toward the pelvis.
Pause without pulling the neck.
Lower the torso slowly to the support.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.reason_uk: primary_muscle=full_body: не визначені конкретні групи для локальної підсвітки v1 без суцільного помаранчевого тіла.
exercises.question_uk: Які конкретні основні й допоміжні м’язи підсвітити?

source_english.description: From a high plank, alternate driving the knees toward the chest while the shoulders stay over the hands.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and bring your right knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring your left knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, keeping your hips low and your core engaged.
Maintain a steady pace and breathe evenly throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Keep shoulders over hands while each knee drives toward the chest.
source_english.safety_note: Use a comfortable range and stop if control or alignment deteriorates.
